title: THE THINGS WE REPEAT
goal: Keep food and water flowing. Weave three cloth to welcome a newcomer. Sustain seven people through day six.
arrival: Five people settle beside an old orchard. Work begins.
pair_bound: The harvest grows larger. The baskets have begun to resist a single pair of hands.
pair_observation: Baskets lift easily with two people, but resist one.
maker_bound: The loom runs faster for its familiar maker. Its threads tighten under other hands.
echo_started: Someone has changed jobs. Their old journey keeps happening without them.
echo_observation: An absent worker's journey is repeating here.
echo_faded: The footsteps grow quiet. The repeated journey has faded.
pair_faded: After empty-handed practice, one person can lift the baskets again.
maker_faded: The threads relax. The loom no longer insists on familiar hands.
practice_started: Workers try the journey without carrying anything.
practice_stopped: Workers resume carrying what they produce.
guest_waiting: A traveler is waiting by the fire. Three cloth will make room for them.
guest_joined: A new pair of hands joins the settlement, knowing none of its strange habits.
shared_meal: Food and water are shared around the fire.
hungry_day: There is not enough food or water. Work is slowing. Four days of shortages will scatter the group.
rain_day: Rain soaks a blanket. One cloth is used keeping the hearth dry.
dispersed: The shortages have scattered the settlement. Start a new world to try another way.
established: The settlement has taken root. Its people and its habits keep growing. You can continue living here.
heavy_fruit: Two hands are no longer enough
map_hint: Drag a person to a place to change their work
controls: People are already working. Drag them between places, or select a person and destination. Space: pause · F8: record this moment.
marked: This moment and its exact world state have been recorded.
unavailable: That order is not available right now.
